# Takeoff UI - Project Structure

Takeoff UI is a web components library developed with Stencil. It provides
wrapper packages for React, Vue, and Angular.

## Package Responsibilities

- **packages/core**: All Stencil component development is done here. It is the
  main development package.
- **packages/react**, **packages/vue**, **packages/angular**: These are wrapper
  packages automatically generated by the Stencil output-target. No manual
  changes are allowed.
- **docs/**: Docusaurus documentation. Playground config 'version' and MDX
  content here.

## Build and Test Commands

- **Bootstrap**: `pnpm install` (Node >= 20.12.2, pnpm >= 8.0.0)
- **Core build**: `pnpm run build --filter=@takeoff-ui/core` veya
  `cd packages/core && pnpm run build`
- **Core test**: `cd packages/core && pnpm run test`
- **Core test (coverage)**: `cd packages/core && pnpm run test.coverage`
- **Lint**: `pnpm run lint`
- **Format**: `pnpm run format`

## Proje Layout

- `packages/core/src/components/`: Stencil components (tk-button, tk-accordion,
  vb.)
- `packages/core/src/utils/`: Helpers used by multiple components
- `packages/core/src/global/interfaces/`: Shared types and interfaces
- `packages/core/src/global/sass/abstracts/_variables.scss`: Figma design tokens

## Important Notes

- When adding new components, `stencil generate` can be used.
- Component development is only done within packages/core.
- Never make manual changes to wrapper packages (react, vue, angular).
